headline.purpose: Page-level and rare; the largest type in the app (19px).

title.purpose: Card titles and primary input default state (15px).

body.purpose: The readable default: chat, hints, paragraph text (13px).

label.purpose: Uppercase, tracked form and section labels (11.5px).

data.purpose: Monospace scientific values: q, score, lattice, Miller indices.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: The only structural shadow. Lifts a floating card off the dark field; inset rim catches a faint top edge of light.

shadows.name: card-lift-light
shadows.purpose: Light-theme equivalent of card-lift; softer and shallower.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Global state transition. Fast, nearly invisible; applied to every element.

motion.name: overlay-fade-in
motion.purpose: Freshly-drawn trace peak and tick marks ease into view.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single assertive action on a surface. Ice-blue fill, reserved.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.82 0.08 220)); border: 1px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.82 0.08 220)); color: #fff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.82 0.08 220)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The default button. No fill, muted text; most chrome buttons are ghost.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--color-fg-muted, oklch(0.64 0.009 250)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.95 0.005 250)); background: var(--color-bg-hover, oklch(0.185 0.007 250)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.82 0.08 220)); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action. Ghost at rest; red text appears only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--color-fg-muted, oklch(0.64 0.009 250)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { color: var(--color-error, oklch(0.70 0.14 28)); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.82 0.08 220)); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed field. Background darker than its container, reading as an inset well.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--color-bg, oklch(0.095 0.004 250)); color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.95 0.005 250)); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.27 0.008 250)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-fg-dim, oklch(0.46 0.009 250)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 1px solid var(--color-accent, oklch(0.82 0.08 220)); border-color: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.82 0.08 220)); }

components.name: Floating Card
components.description: The one surface that floats. 12px corners, hairline border, deep ambient lift.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-bg-elevated, oklch(0.145 0.006 250)); color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.95 0.005 250)); border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-soft, oklch(0.21 0.007 250)); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03) inset, 0 12px 36px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.7); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.27 0.008 250)); font: 600 15px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Score Bar
components.description: A 2px capsule track filled to a score percentage in the relevant phase color. Evidence without a shouting number.
components.css: .ds-scorebar { height: 2px; width: 180px; background: var(--color-bg-hover, oklch(0.185 0.007 250)); border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-scorebar-fill { display: block; height: 100%; width: 82%; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.78 0.12 160); }

components.name: Semantic Dot
components.description: The canonical second channel: an 8px color disc paired with an accessible label so meaning survives color blindness.
components.html: Im3m
components.css: .ds-dot-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; background: oklch(0.78 0.12 160); } .ds-dot-label { font: 500 11.5px/1.4 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; color: var(--color-fg, oklch(0.95 0.005 250)); }

components.name: Phase Chip
components.description: A monospace strong-data badge naming a phase; the instrument voice for a categorical result.
components.css: .ds-phase-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 11.5px/1.4 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; color: oklch(0.80 0.13 62); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.80 0.13 62) 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.80 0.13 62) 12%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: HimalayaUI works the way a darkroom works. The room is kept dark on purpose, not for mood, but so the thing that matters can be seen: the diffraction signal. The detector image, the 1D integration trace, and the Miller plot are luminous objects floating on a near-black field. Everything else, the chrome, the cards, the labels, recedes into shadow so the eye goes straight to the data. The personality is a confident expert who happens to be quiet: the interface makes calls and shows its reasoning, but never raises its voice. Density is high and deliberate; color is rationed and semantic.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black cool-gray field (hue 250) so luminous data leads; chrome recedes.
One ice-blue accent, rationed; magenta reserved for manual edits; an 8-hue semantic phase palette.
Dense, small type: a five-step scale from 10.5px to 19px, never extended ad hoc.
Cards float on deep ambient shadow; everything else is flat.
Fast, near-invisible motion: 120ms ease-out, no choreography, no bounce.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Every color is a label. If a color does not encode meaning (interaction, provenance, phase, status), it does not belong on the screen. Decorative color is a bug.

rules.name: The Second-Channel Rule
rules.body: No meaning is ever carried by hue alone. Every color-coded element pairs its hue with a second channel: a shape, a text label, a position, or a pattern.

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: The ice-blue accent appears on a small fraction of any screen. Its calm and its rarity are what make it read as interactive rather than decorated.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Five type steps, full stop. If a size seems missing, extend the scale in styles.css as a deliberate, reviewed change. Never scatter a one-off text-[14px].

rules.name: The Monospace-Means-Measurement Rule
rules.body: The mono face is for values produced by the instrument: q, score, lattice constants, Miller indices. Never use it for prose.

rules.name: The Flat-Except-Cards Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Depth is conveyed by tonal steps in the neutral ramp, not by shadow. The single exception is the card, which floats.

dos: Do keep the dark field as the default and let the diffraction data be the brightest thing on screen.
Do treat every color as a label: accent for interaction, peak-manual magenta only for hand-added peaks, the phase palette only for phase encoding, status colors only for status.
Do pair every color encoding with a second channel: a shape, a label, a position.
Do stay inside the five-step type scale; extend the scale in styles.css if a size is missing.
Do set scientific values in the monospace face and prose in Plus Jakarta Sans.
Do make buttons ghost by default; reserve the ice-blue primary fill for the single main action.
Do verify contrast at WCAG AA in both the dark and light themes.
donts: Don't look like legacy scientific software: no toolbar soup, no grey system chrome, no widget pile.
Don't look like a generic SaaS dashboard: no hero-metric tiles, no identical card grids, no decorative gradient accents.
Don't look like a consumer or playful app: nothing rounded for charm, no bright primary colors, no mascots.
Don't look like a bare academic utility: an unstyled, function-only Jupyter-notebook-as-a-product.
Don't carry meaning by hue alone; an index or peak distinguished only by color is broken under color blindness.
Don't use #000 or #fff as a surface or text color; every neutral is tinted to hue 250.
Don't give a drop shadow to anything that is not a card.
Don't add bounce, elastic, or scroll-driven motion; transitions are 120ms ease-out.
Don't inline one-off type sizes; extend the scale instead.
